CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Smoothly return to level, forward flight.
CONTROLS.NAME: recenter

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Forward flight speed in units per second. The fractal repeats every 6 units.
CONTROLS.NAME: fly_speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Nose up/down. Steers your path through the fractal cosmos.
CONTROLS.NAME: pitch

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How far the ray travels before fading into background. Lower = cozier/closer. Higher = more structure visible at once.
CONTROLS.NAME: draw_distance

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Mandelbox scale — reshapes the fractal entirely. -1.5 = dense caves. -2.0 = balanced (default). -3.0 = crystal lattice.
CONTROLS.NAME: box_scale

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Size of the decorative circle-grid overlay on the fractal surface and glow.
CONTROLS.NAME: pattern_scale

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Speed of the pattern rotation and beat-sync color drift.
CONTROLS.NAME: color_speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Intensity of the volumetric glow halo around fractal surfaces. Higher = more nebula, more bloom.
CONTROLS.NAME: glow_amount

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Base hue for the cosine color palette. Full turn cycles through the entire spectrum.
CONTROLS.NAME: base_hue

DESCRIPTION: Fly through an infinite Mandelbox fractal cosmos. The fractal tiles endlessly in every direction — there are no walls, no edges. Volumetric glow makes the structure bloom like a nebula. Bass pulses the brightness.
TITLE: Natalie's Fractal
